summary: Retroactive rate-tier adjustment after subaccount aggregation leading to invoice delta and credit request
description:
Issue summary:
Customer BrightPath Health reports a material credit is missing after month-end consolidation of subaccount usage. During monthly billing the platform re-evaluated rate tiers after aggregating three subaccounts under the same billing org, which reduced unit price tiers across several line items. The expected retroactive credit was not applied to invoice INV-2026-03-10-7834.

Impact:
- Customer expected a ~$7.8k credit for February usage after consolidated tiering.
- Finance team and customer are requesting an immediate correction or one-time manual credit.
- Customer is an Enterprise contract (SLA/finance escalation).

Environment:
- Production billing pipeline for org brightpath-health (org_id: bh-8472).
- Billing job run: billing-job-2026-03-01-agg-v4.
- Regions: us-east; meter type: token-generation (text-gen-3-large).

Steps to reproduce / observed behavior:
1) Run aggregation logic on subaccounts A/B/C (IDs bh-sa-01 / bh-sa-02 / bh-sa-03) for Feb 2026.
2) Aggregation crosses the 500M token tier threshold reducing per-token price for multiple line items.
3) Billing calc should compute retroactive delta and create a credit memo applied to the Mar invoice or adjust Feb invoice.
4) Invoice INV-2026-03-10-7834 does not contain the expected credit memo; net due remains unchanged.

Logs / evidence:
- Billing job log snippet (billing-job-2026-03-01-agg-v4) shows aggregation produced new tier levels (see log markers: [AGG-THRESHOLD-APPLIED] and [TIER-DELTA-CALC]).
- Finance export (billing_export_2026_03_02.csv) shows expected credit line but no matching credit memo id in invoice table.
- Customer supplied screenshot of invoice and contract tier schedule.

Requested outcome:
- Confirm whether the billing pipeline omitted generation/application of the credit memo or if credit was generated but not attached to invoice.
- If omitted, create manual credit equal to $7,842.34 and apply to the customer's account immediately OR issue corrected invoice for Feb 2026.
- Provide root cause and timeline for permanent fix.
comments: 2026-03-10 Priya Desai (Support): Opened ticket after CS escalated—customer needs urgent finance action; attaching logs and customer invoice screenshot.
2026-03-10 Ethan Morales (Billing Eng): Acknowledged. Pulling billing-job logs and cross-checking credit memo generator. Assigned to billing-service owners.
2026-03-11 Jenna Park (Finance): Finance export shows delta row but no credit_memo_id. Possible race where credit memo job failed after aggregation. Requesting job run id and raw tiering table.

2026-03-11 Alex Chen (Backend): Found error in billing-worker-credits: job attempted to write credit memo but received 409 conflict when writing to invoice ledger; retry logic suppressed duplicate, resulting in no memo. Opening PR to add compensating transaction. See related PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing-service/pull/612.
2026-03-12 Priya Desai (Support): Customer confirmed they will accept a manual credit now and reconciliation report when fixed. Asked for ETA and confirmation once credit posted.
2026-03-12 Finance (Jenna Park): Issued one-time manual credit CM-2026-03-12-BH-001 for $7,842.34 and applied to BrightPath account; awaiting Support to confirm customer sees credit on portal.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: aggregation and tiering calculation completed correctly (logs show TIER-DELTA-CALC). Secondary failure appears in credit memo persistence step: billing-worker-credits attempted ledger write but received 409 conflict due to concurrent invoice-lock held by monthly finalization job. Retry suppressed by idempotency guard. Reproducible locally by forcing concurrent finalization + credit write. Root causes: (1) inadequate coordination between finalization and credit write phases; (2) idempotency guard does not surface failed write for manual intervention. Related code path: billing-service/credits/credit_writer.go. Triage: escalate to payments/finance and schedule hotfix for credit_writer retry behavior.
resolution_notes: One-time manual credit CM-2026-03-12-BH-001 created and applied. Finance confirmed balance adjusted and refund not required. Customer portal shows credit and account balance is reconciled. Temporary mitigation: change finalization window to avoid concurrent credit writes for affected orgs (applied for March run). Permanent fix: PR 612 modifies credit_writer to surface failure and enqueue a compensating retry task; PR slated for patch deploy 2026-03-16 after QA signoff.
suggested_fix: Deploy PR 612 to billing-service which adds compensating retry and clearer error surface to support. Update runbook to pause invoice-finalize lock during credit writer runs for aggregated orgs. Add monitoring alert when expected credit memos are not present within 24h after aggregation (metric: billing.expected_credit_memos_missing_count).
follow_up_actions: Finance to confirm final ledger state and send reconciliation CSV to customer (due 2026-03-13)
Engineering to deploy PR 612 and verify March run (ETA 2026-03-16)
